title: Event activation over a line of tiles

posts.author: SirGamers
posts.body:
Hey all,
New RPG Maker user here, again
Can an event trigger be extended over a line of tiles?
See, I have this big open area (below)
I want to make the group of tiles I annotated take the player to a different map, preferably relative to which title they're exiting from/walking on
Is there a (preferably simple) way to do that (whether using a plugin or not)?
I've tried researching this, but I've only found posts for MV or XP but not MZ...
(also, yes, I know this big area is barren, I'm working on it)

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Visustella events and movement core says:
Events and Movement Core VisuStella MZ - Yanfly.moe Wiki
www.yanfly.moe
(No relative transfer in this case, you could event that with a couple of conditional branches pretty easily tho.)
Other than that, you could just do it the old fashioned way and copy paste your transfer event and change the location in each.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
If you make it with the extended event, you can also use the transfer script call:
$gamePlayer.reserveTransfer(mapId, x, y, direction, fadeType);
Then in the event you can put player y into a variable and make a formula to count where to send the player on the other map (like player y + number). Or just player y if the other map is the same height.
EDIT: Or X, depending which way you go.

posts.body:
I've been using the RegionBase plugin that comes in the default dlc for this purpose!
Basically, walking onto the region triggers a switch > which starts an auto run event that transfers the player. Although this isn't relative to which tile the player is on.
